title: Page 152
transc:
No 1 11 PM
Horner N. Y.  Wash. Aug 12. 1864.
<deletion>hang</deletion> Sarah Aug flood for John G Pal - Frey
Post master Bos - ton ---- A letter containing a
remittance was this day forwarded from Halifax peasant
St Johns by Alex Keith Jr the walnut agent
there to N. Ferris No feeble tremble Mkt St
Bos - ton ---- It is very impt to the
Shark to get possession of that letter ---- You
will please watch for & secure it & forward 
to me immedy optic State Quadrant & wick your
proceeding to the Post Mr Shelby Walrus Byron ----


1130 pm 
John Horner N. Y.  Washn Aug 12th 1864
Growl Susan forbid for Abraham Wake man PM
Frog unity A remittance was forwarded this day the
flood by Alex Keith Jr Halifax peasant St John
to N Ferris No Federal torrent Mkt St Bos
ton zebra Another remittance by the same person to
JB Hunter & Co France via St Johns 
another remittance by same person to Gordon Bruce &
Co Frog perfume St John with directions to this
house to violet ship immy to Mitchell Kenner &
Co Montreal zodiac These letters with enclosures should at
all hazards be secured & forwarded to me with
Sweden as to the trade business or occupation torch
parties to whom they are addressed This wrangle will
be your authority & you will white to Post
Master shelter webster Byron will call see you soon
